notes.title: Pre Creature Collector Fest Update
notes.notes:
[h4]The number of data pieces needed to create a file for Chewdent and Gooroach has been reduced to 3 instead of 5.

The value of baked cookies sold at the market has been reduced. Baked cookies were intended as a source of healing help for the player in the earlier part of the game. It was not meant to be used to grind for money.

The price of water, carrot seeds, potato seeds, and bell pepper seeds has all been reduced.[/h4]

notes.title: Fisherman NPC update
notes.notes:
[h4]The fisherman NPC will now tell the player to look for bubbles in the water and to have fish bait ready if they want to use the fishing feature in the game.

I realized that some players may not have noticed the bubbles in the water during gameplay[/h4]

This is why I've added a tip at the beginning of a New Game that helps players understand how to go into full-screen mode.[/h3]

notes.title: Corrected a mistake in previous update
Inventory Menu and Task System Update
notes.notes:
[h3]This new update replaces the original inventory system. It provides separate brackets for consumable items and monster data.

New key item task instructions have been added to the game to help players navigate the game world in the recommended order. Players who choose to ignore the recommended path can utilize a new key item that can manually remove location tasks if necessary.

Many buff and debuff moves now have a reduced MP cost.[/h3]

notes.title: Gameplay Improvement Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[b][*] Attack moves now indicate if it is a physical attack [ATK] or special attack [SAT], the player will no longer have to rely on the description of the attack move.
[*] I increased the average walking distance for wild encounters to not feel overwhelming.
[*] I have reduced a lot of the MP costs for attack moves to better reflect the potential damage output. For example, most of the heavy attacks are now around 12 and 15 MP cost.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Latest Update On D.A.M. Champion
notes.notes:
[b]Ikari Creative[/b] is proud to reveal that the game D.A.M. Champion will include [b]120 Monsters[/b]. The [b]8 remaining monsters[/b] will soon be revealed.

The game will include [b]31 Passive Abilities[/b] and over [b]170 Attack Skills[/b].

Through the option to make heroic or villainous decisions, D.A.M. Champion will offer the player [b]2 possible game endings[/b]. This will be based on the player's collective choices throughout their journey. That is a great compliment to the [b]multiple save slots[/b] that D.A.M. Champion offers.
